opportunities.name_zh: 黃花亭金針花田與山景

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"黃花亭 Camera Zone","subject":"daylily fields + mountain slopes + East Rift Valley landscape"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法步行與觀景區可達；遵守花季交通與現場停車管制
condition_variants.required_conditions: 8–9 月花季；降雨未妨礙拍攝；花田與山坡輪廓可辨
condition_variants.boosters: 柔和側光；雲影形成丘陵層次；高能見度
condition_variants.penalties: 持續降雨；濃霧完全遮蔽山坡；花況未達預期

viewpoints.note: Huanghua Pavilion photography zone; parking/arrival is modeled separately.
viewpoints.name: 黃花亭 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 代表黃花亭周邊合法觀景與花田構圖區，不宣稱唯一腳架位置。

opportunities.name_zh: 小瑞士金針花坡與丘陵曲線
opportunities.best_time: 8–9 月花季；午後斜射光較有層次

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"小瑞士觀景台 Camera Zone","subject":"daylily slope + rolling hills + layered light"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法步行觀景區可達；小瑞士旁禁停時不得以 Camera Zone 當停車導航終點
condition_variants.required_conditions: 8–9 月花季；降雨未妨礙拍攝；近中距離丘陵可辨
condition_variants.boosters: 午後斜射光；雲影；花坡明暗層次
condition_variants.penalties: 持續降雨；低雲完全遮蔽丘陵；花況未達預期

viewpoints.note: Photography point only; not a verified parking destination.
viewpoints.name: 小瑞士觀景台 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 攝影點；花季小瑞士旁禁止停車，導航不得把此點標為停車場。

opportunities.name_zh: 忘憂亭縱谷雲隙光與夕照
opportunities.best_time: 15:00–17:00；官方旅遊資料列為雲隙光常見拍攝時段
opportunities.best_season: 8–9 月花季；全年仍可拍縱谷夕照

condition_variants.variant_name: 忘憂亭西向縱谷雲隙光
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"忘憂亭 Camera Zone","subject":"East Rift Valley + Central Mountain Range + cloud-gap sunbeams","view_direction":"west"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法觀景區可達；遵守現場交通與停車管制
condition_variants.required_conditions: 15:00–17:00 時段優先；西向天空需有雲層與可形成直射光的破口；不可僅以晴天推定雲隙光成立
condition_variants.boosters: 中低層碎雲與雲縫；西向直射光；雨後空氣較乾淨
condition_variants.penalties: 全晴無雲無法形成雲隙光；厚低雲封住西向天空；持續降雨

viewpoints.note: West-facing photography zone near Wangyou Pavilion; parking/arrival kept separate.
viewpoints.name: 忘憂亭 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 代表忘憂亭周邊西向縱谷構圖區；非唯一腳架點。
